name: Plate Halo
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and grip a light weight plate by its opposite edges in front of your chest.
Brace your core and keep your head still as you orbit the plate smoothly around one ear and behind the back of your head.
Continue circling the plate around the opposite ear and back in front of your chest with controlled elbows.
Alternate directions smoothly or complete continuous circles for the target duration before lowering the plate.
tips: Move the plate cleanly around your head rather than bobbing your head around the plate.
Keep your ribs stacked over your pelvis without flaring your lower back as the plate passes behind you.
